comparison.objective: Orient an angle-grinder guard toward the operator and clamp it securely.
comparison.physical_skill: Release, rotate, and reclamp an adjustable guard while stabilizing the tool and avoiding the disc.
comparison.success_condition: Guard faces the operator within tolerance, clamp lever flat, grinder unmoved, and hands/tools clear.
comparison.reason: This is guarded rotational adjustment and clamping, not translational transfer between continuous guide surfaces.
